concept_uz: Egizaklar «÷»ni uxlayotgan qirolning ustiga qoʻyadi: 1 ÷ 0. Qirol javob izlab kichrayadi va oʻngga yuguradi — 10, 100, 1000… Minusjon sakrasa — chapga, −1000. U hech qachon yetib bormaydi: ufqda Cheksizlik tugʻiladi. Birinchi qonun: «Noʻlga boʻlib boʻlmaydi».

facts.claim: nolga boʻlish aniqlanmagan; cheksizlik son emas

style_line: Premium 3D animated feature film style, warm golden light, soft shadows, rich colours, vertical 9:16. No text, no captions, no letters or numerals written anywhere, no watermark.

refs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A round golden ring-shaped king: a smooth, thick, upright gold ring like a donut standing on its edge, with big kind expressive eyes and a small mouth on the front of the ring, thin cartoon arms and legs, a small jewelled crown tilted to the left, holding a long plain wooden staff. He stands in the middle of a vast empty golden plain at sunrise, front view, centred.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A slim upright sun-gold character shaped like a tall narrow pillar with a small slanted flag-like tip at the top, big cheerful eyes, a wide smile, thin cartoon arms and legs, and a small round badge with a plus sign pinned on its chest. It stands on a vast golden plain at sunrise, front view, centred.

Change this character: exactly the same shape, size and face, but made of shining moon-silver instead of gold, eyebrows lowered in a grumpy frown, arms crossed, and a horizontal dark-blue sash wrapped across its middle instead of the plus badge. Same plain, same framing, full body, front view.

Vertical 9:16 wide landscape. A vast empty golden plain under a huge sky, a warm sun low on the right horizon and a pale smiling moon with a gentle old woman's face on the left side of the sky, soft morning light, a faint straight line on the ground running from left to right through the centre. No characters.

Vertical 9:16. The same golden plain seen from ground level, and on the very far horizon a tiny glowing silhouette of a running young man made of sparkling light, half dissolved into the haze, always far away. Dramatic dusk light, sparks drifting toward the horizon.

Night. The ring-king lies asleep on his back on the golden plain, crown over his eyes. Above him the gold character balances on a glowing toy shaped like a short horizontal bar with one dot above it and one dot below it. Keep both designs exactly the same. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.prompt: The gold character leans down from the glowing toy above the sleeping king and whispers mischievously: it says in Uzbek with a bright, cheerful young boy's voice: "Hazratim, meni teng bo'lish uchun nechta siz kerak?" The ring-king's eyes snap wide open. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Hazratim, meni teng boʻlish uchun nechta siz kerak?

scenes.prompt: The ring-king shrinks to a tenth of his size and ten tiny copies of him appear in a row; he starts running to the right across the plain and says in Uzbek with a warm, slightly dramatic middle-aged male voice: "O'n!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

He shrinks even smaller and sprints faster and faster to the right, his crown flying off, his staff left behind, dust trailing, and he says in Uzbek with a warm, slightly dramatic middle-aged male voice: "Yuz! Ming! Million!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

The silver character jumps onto the glowing toy with a thud. The running king skids, spins around and sprints just as madly to the LEFT. The silver character says in Uzbek with a slightly croaky, grumpy young boy's voice: "Endi menga!" and the king, running away, says in Uzbek with a warm, slightly dramatic middle-aged male voice: "Minus ming!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

Sparks stream from the horizon behind the running king toward the far edge of the world, where a glowing figure of light appears. From the horizon a far-away voice says in Uzbek with a far-away, echoing young man's voice: "Yetib keldim!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

The camera zooms fast toward the horizon — but the figure of light is still exactly as far away. The twins squint into the distance. The far-away voice says in Uzbek with a far-away, echoing young man's voice: "…Yo'q, hali yo'ldaman." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

Dawn. The exhausted ring-king, crownless and panting, stands in the middle of the plain, raises his staff high and says in Uzbek with a warm, slightly dramatic middle-aged male voice: "No'lga bo'lib bo'lmaydi!" The twins bow their heads, then hug each other to apologise — POP — they vanish. The king facepalms. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

The ring-king waves his staff and golden sparks form a long line of new number-characters of all sizes stretching toward the horizon like a wall. At the end of the line a few of them turn around, cross their arms and frown rebelliously. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a warm storyteller's male voice: "Davomi — powerty.uz da." No subtitles, no on-screen text.
